extracted.name: Classic Spanish Sangria
extracted.description: This fruity sangria makes a tangy-sweet cocktail. Add different fruits to make it season-specific, like apples or pears for fall or berries for summer.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 cup white sugar, or to taste
instruction_lines: Refrigerate orange, lemon, lime, wine, rum, and orange juice until cold.
Slice orange, lemon, and lime into thin rounds. Place in a large glass pitcher. Add rum and sugar. Refrigerate to allow flavors to blend, about 2 hours.
Crush fruit lightly with a wooden spoon. Stir in wine and orange juice. Adjust sweetness as desired.
